title: Surface scoped device-token issuance in the Studio Integrations UI

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0061 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-24 directive to build the next frontier node after CHG-0060. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0061.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-24 user directive 'dale al merge y a lo que sigue'.

claims.statement: AC-016's device-token least-privilege (a token executes only its selected actions for its Show, and cross-Show, undeclared, expired and revoked actions are denied) is already proven at the integration tier by the device-credential HTTP tests. Only surfacing device-token issuance through the Studio Integrations UI remained; the IntegrationsView was a PLANNED placeholder.
claims.evidence: server/tests/unit/deviceCredentialsHttp.test.ts and the prior IntegrationsView placeholder recorded in CHG-0060.

claims.statement: The change replaces the Integrations placeholder with a real surface: the owner picks a Show, a label, a control id and the action scopes (visibility control, state feedback), issues a device token through the owner-only device-credential endpoint, and the token is displayed exactly once (data-testid=device-token with a SHOWN ONCE affordance and a shown-once warning). A browser test drives the real Studio SPA against the real server to prove the round-trip.

Governed discovery reordered the work: the UI is a thin, evidence-only surface over the existing owner-only device-credential endpoint, so the slice proves the browser round-trip (owner issues a scoped token, token shown once) first, not any new server authority. No server or protocol behavior changes.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-24; the endpoint POST /api/shows/:showId/integrations/device-credentials and its owner-role gate predate this change.

claims.statement: Driving the real Studio Integrations surface to issue a Show-scoped device token and asserting that a token matching /^ok_device_/ is shown exactly once proves AC-016's UI half. server/tests/e2e/studioIntegrations.test.ts is the falsification mechanism.
claims.evidence: server/tests/e2e/studioIntegrations.test.ts issues a token through the browser and asserts the shown-once token value and affordance.

claims.statement: The UI does not prove least-privilege enforcement. Cross-Show, undeclared, expired and revoked denial remain proven only at the integration tier; the Integrations surface proves only that an owner can issue a scoped token and that it is shown once.
claims.evidence: server/tests/unit/deviceCredentialsHttp.test.ts holds the enforcement proofs; studioIntegrations.test.ts asserts only issuance and shown-once.

claims.statement: Human review accepted CHG-0061: an owner issues a Show-scoped device token through the Studio Integrations surface and the token is shown exactly once, proving AC-016's UI half at the browser tier. Least-privilege enforcement stays proven at the integration tier; listing, rotating and revoking device credentials through the UI stays deferred.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/IntegrationsView.vue, server/tests/e2e/studioIntegrations.test.ts, the passing full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0061 pull-request Constitution run (8 jobs green), and human acceptance on 2026-08-24.

claims.statement: Rotating, revoking and listing issued device credentials through the Studio UI remains deferred to a successor; no GET list route for issued credentials exists yet.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/deviceCredentials.ts exposes create, rotate and delete but no list route.

claims.statement: No server or protocol code changes. The change is Studio UI plus a browser test, and a .gitignore entry for the vitest DATA_DIR (server/.test-data/) so test runs do not dirty the tree.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0061 branch: studio/src/views/IntegrationsView.vue, server/tests/e2e/studioIntegrations.test.ts and .gitignore only.

successCriteria.statement: An owner issues a Show-scoped device token through the Studio Integrations surface and the token is shown exactly once.
successCriteria.verification: The browser test navigates to /settings/integrations, clicks Issue device token, and asserts a token matching /^ok_device_/ with a SHOWN ONCE affordance.

successCriteria.statement: The issued token is bound to the selected Show with the selected scopes and a declared control.
successCriteria.verification: The device-credential POST returns 201 with credential.showId equal to the selected Show and the requested scopes and controlIds.

successCriteria.statement: No existing behavior regresses and the UI type-checks.
successCriteria.verification: The full server suite passes and the Studio type-check passes.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0061 records the AC-016 UI half — the browser round-trip proof, the enforcement that stays at the integration tier, and the deferred rotate/revoke/list — before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: IntegrationsView issues a scoped device token and shows it exactly once, and a browser test proves the owner round-trip against the real server.
The browser test passes and the full server suite passes.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, type-check and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
